mapping_method: Preserve all154 previous mappings except explicit genuine Q18 survival additions; append all9 surviving real-core questions before any expanded answers. Separate unasked key background. Reachability credit remains separate from grading requirements.
grading_scope: Judge all actually requested material facts using equivalent wording and implied actors in context. A fixed key may include explanatory background; key_context_not_required is not an additional answer requirement or tested source coverage. A response need not recite stipulated givens or a counting guard if its answer already respects them.

questions.question: In a Ravage a land has one Town, one Explorer and two undamaged Dahan, with no Defend or prior Blight. Resolve damage to land, Dahan, surviving counterattack and resulting Fear if the players destroy the Town.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a Ravage a land has one Town, one Explorer and two undamaged Dahan, with no Defend or prior Blight. Resolve damage to land, Dahan, surviving counterattack and resulting Fear if the players destroy the Town.
required_facts: Town plus Explorer deal 3 Damage simultaneously to land and Dahan.
Add one Blight to the previously unblighted land.
Destroy one Dahan efficiently and mark 1 Damage on the survivor.
The surviving Dahan still deals 2 counterattack Damage.
Destroying the chosen Town generates 1 Fear.

key_context_not_required.fact: Partial Dahan Damage clears at Time Passes.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The question ends with this Ravage and resulting Fear, not end-of-turn healing.

questions.question: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: In a two-Spirit game with 7 of 8 Fear markers already generated, an effect generates 3 Fear and earning a card exposes Terror II. Explain marker handling, new Terror timing, and when the card is revealed/resolved.
required_facts: The eighth Fear marker earns the top card face-down, then reset all 8 markers.
The remaining 2 generated Fear go toward the next card.
Exposed Terror II takes effect immediately.
Do not reveal the earned card until Fear resolution; resolve it at the then-current Terror level.

key_context_not_required.fact: Outcome check occurs at action-tree end.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt asks marker handling, Terror timing and Fear-card reveal/resolution, not a victory/defeat check.

key_context_not_required.fact: An initial stack of earned Fear cards is resolved in earned order.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The given effect earns one card. The prompt asks its reveal/resolution time and Terror level, not the ordering of an initial multi-card earned stack.

questions.question: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A land with existing Blight has two Presence from Spirit A and one from Spirit B. One new Blight is added after setup. Describe Presence losses, cascade choices and what happens if the cascade enters another already-Blighted land.
required_facts: Destroy one Presence from A and one from B; put them beside the island, not back on tracks.
Add the original Blight and cascade one additional Blight to one chosen adjacent land.
If that land already had Blight, destroy one Presence of each Spirit present and cascade onward again.
Existing Blight quantity does not multiply the outgoing cascade.

questions.question: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: How do Damage, Destroy, Remove and Replace differ for Fear and survival? Can Damage from separate normal Powers combine, does Damage normally hurt Dahan, and does replacement erase prior Damage?
required_facts: Unqualified Power Damage normally hurts Invaders in the target land; it does not normally harm Dahan.
Damage from normal separate Powers can combine during the turn.
Damage reaching Health immediately destroys a piece; survivor Damage clears at Time Passes.
Destroying a Town/City causes 1/2 Fear in addition to explicit Fear.
Remove/Replace themselves generate no destruction Fear.
Replace retains prior Damage and can cause destruction if it meets the new piece's Health.
An outright Destroy instruction eliminates its specified piece regardless of current Damage or Health, unlike Damage that must reach Health.
Remove also takes the specified piece off the board without a Damage/Health test; its no-automatic-Fear distinction remains required.
Replace removes the original piece and puts the specified replacement in its place; preserve the existing retained-Damage/new-Health-destruction requirement.

key_context_not_required.fact: An ordinary Power Damage budget may be distributed among Invaders in its target land as desired.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The comparison is explicitly for Fear and survival, followed by accumulation, Dahan recipients and retained replacement Damage. It never asks how freely a Damage budget can be split among different Invaders.

questions.question: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: If a Ravage in one land cascades Blight across the board boundary, is that cascade a separate independent action for victory/defeat checks? May players choose another land’s Ravage first to win before a later losing Ravage?
required_facts: A cascade is part of the original single-land Ravage action tree, including across boards.
It is not an independent outcome-check boundary.
Players may choose the land order and win after one complete Ravage tree before a later land would cause loss.

questions.question: The Trees and Stones Speak of War is used with five Dahan and its threshold Pushes two to different adjacent lands. How much Defend stays and reaches each destination? Does a later unrelated Dahan move carry it further?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: The Trees and Stones Speak of War is used with five Dahan and its threshold Pushes two to different adjacent lands. How much Defend stays and reaches each destination? Does a later unrelated Dahan move carry it further?
required_facts: After the threshold Pushes two to different lands, Defend 6 remains and each destination gets Defend 2.
Later unrelated movement does not carry it again.

key_context_not_required.fact: Additional Defend boosts in original land stay there.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The stated case has no additional Defend boost, and the question only asks the specified five-Dahan distribution and later movement.

key_context_not_required.fact: Destination Dahan already present do not multiply the transported Defend.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The prompt gives no preexisting Dahan in either destination; only the stated five-Dahan Defend distribution and later unrelated movement are requested.

questions.question: When Ocean Drowns a Town and a City, when is Fear earned and where do pieces go? In two-Spirit play how much Energy value is a drowned City worth, can change be made, and do Dahan yield Energy?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: When Ocean Drowns a Town and a City, when is Fear earned and where do pieces go? In two-Spirit play how much Energy value is a drowned City worth, can change be made, and do Dahan yield Energy?
required_facts: Drowning a Town/City earns 1/2 Fear immediately, not when traded for Energy.
Store drowned Invaders on Ocean's panel for trade.
Trade X Health for 1 Energy, where X is Spirit count.
In two-Spirit play a City can give 1 Energy plus 1 Health change; making change is allowed.
Drowned Dahan provide no Energy.

key_context_not_required.fact: Ignore Invader Health modifiers when trading.
key_context_not_required.why_not_requested: The given City has no Health modifier; the question asks its ordinary two-Spirit value/change and Dahan benefit.

questions.question: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Bringer uses a 2-Damage Power and then a separate 1-Damage Power on an undamaged City. What happens? What if 2 then 1 Damage are instructions within a single Power, and may a Repeat pretend-destroy the same piece again?
required_facts: Separate 2- and 1-Damage Bringer Powers each fail to pretend-destroy an undamaged City and leave no hypothetical Damage.
A single Power with 2 then 1 Damage combines its instructions and pretend-destroys that City for 5 Fear without actual destruction.
A Repeat is a separate use and can pretend-destroy the same piece again if that use suffices.
Hypothetical Damage cannot combine across the original and Repeat.

questions.question: A City has 2 real Damage from another Spirit. Bringer then uses a 1-Damage Power twice via a Repeat. How much Fear does each use earn, does the City die, and is its real Damage erased?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: A City has 2 real Damage from another Spirit. Bringer then uses a 1-Damage Power twice via a Repeat. How much Fear does each use earn, does the City die, and is its real Damage erased?
required_facts: The City's 2 real Damage lets each 1-Damage nightmare use pretend-destroy it.
Each use earns 5 Fear, totaling 10.
The City survives and its existing 2 real Damage stays unchanged.

Where is it for a Spirit-targeting Power used by Spirit A that instructs Spirit B to act? Which Spirit’s Range bonuses apply, and if that internal arrow is Range 1 with A having +2 and B having no bonus, what Range can it reach from whose Presence? How does Blazing Renewal’s explicit measurement origin differ?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: For a Range arrow within a Power’s effect text, where is the origin for a land-targeting Power? Where is it for a Spirit-targeting Power used by Spirit A that instructs Spirit B to act? Which Spirit’s Range bonuses apply, and if that internal arrow is Range 1 with A having +2 and B having no bonus, what Range can it reach from whose Presence? How does Blazing Renewal’s explicit measurement origin differ?
required_facts: A land-targeting Power's internal Range originates at target land unless specified otherwise.
For a Spirit-targeting Power, normally measure from Presence of the Spirit following the instruction, B here.
Use the Power user A's Range bonuses, not B's.
The given internal Range 1 with A's +2 reaches Range 3 from B's Presence.
Blazing Renewal explicitly measures from Power user A's Presence even when B places Presence, overriding the default.

questions.question: Dread Apparitions has already resolved in a land. A normal Spirit Power there generates 1 printed Fear and destroys one Town, generating another 1 Fear. Which of those Fear sources count for Dread Apparitions, and counting only this later Power’s Fear, how much additional Defend does it add? Separately, Bringer’s Power there generates exactly 2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths pretend-destroying a Town and no other Fear. Does that Fear count, and how much additional Defend is added?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Fear-source eligibility and increment from normal Power
required_facts: Printed Power Fear counts.
Ordinary Town-destruction Fear does not count.
The later normal Power adds Defend1, not2, excluding earlier Defend.
The2 Fear from To Dream a Thousand Deaths counts.
That Fear adds Defend2.

questions.question: Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship must Push three Explorers, and three distinct adjacent legal destination lands are available. May all three be sent to one land, or must they be split? If only two legal destination lands are available, what distribution restriction remains?

requested_clauses.actual_requested_clause: Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship must Push three Explorers, and three distinct adjacent legal destination lands are available. May all three be sent to one land, or must they be split? If only two legal destination lands are available, what distribution restriction remains?
required_facts: Dissolve requires its Explorer Push to use as many different legal destination lands as possible.
With three pushed Explorers and three legal destination lands, send one Explorer to each of those three lands.
With only two legal destination lands, use both: one receives two Explorers and the other one.
